summary: SFUSD's Mission Bay School is an 81,800 sq ft, four-story TK-5 campus at 1415 Owens St designed by DLR Group and built by McCarthy Building Companies under a $95.39M design-build contract funded by the 2016 Proposition A school facilities bond; it opened to its first PreK/TK/K students on August 17, 2026, becoming Mission Bay's first public school and SFUSD's first new school in two decades.

milestones.text: The Mission Bay Redevelopment Plan designates this site for a future public school
UCSF transfers the school site to SFUSD (set aside for a school since 1988 per this project's own sourcing)
SFUSD announces it has hired DLR Group (design architect) and McCarthy Building Companies (design-build contractor); Multistudio serves as bridging-documents architect
Official groundbreaking ceremony, attended by Mayor London Breed, Board of Education President Jenny Lam and SFUSD Superintendent Dr. Matt Wayne
First students (Pre-K, TK, combined TK-K special ed, and Kindergarten) begin attending under Principal Monette Benitez
School is planned to grow one grade per year into a full TK-5 (with Preschool) campus

costs.what: SFUSD's design-build construction contract with McCarthy Building Companies
Total project cost cited at the August 2026 opening (broader than the McCarthy construction contract; likely includes design, site work, FF&E and soft costs, not itemized in the source)

facts.value: 1415 Owens St (at 6th St/Mission Bay Blvd S)
SFUSD's 2016 Proposition A school facilities bond (voter-approved)
Reported inconsistently: 'more than 400 students' at full build-out (2026 report) vs. 'up to 550' and '600' in 2022 pre-construction reporting -- not reconciled, see open questions

Designed to be twice as sustainable as SFUSD's standard, aligned with the Architecture 2030 Challenge; Universal Design for Learning with movable glass partitions joining classrooms; ground-floor spaces with direct outdoor access; built-in classroom observation rooms for teacher training on each floor
A 'Mission Bay Hub' STEM/Linked Learning program serving high schoolers from six SF high schools (health/bioscience career pathway), plus district professional-development space

open_questions: Full-build-out (2032) enrollment capacity is not consistently reported across sources ('more than 400', 'up to 550', '600'); no SFUSD primary-source capacity figure was found.

Total project cost is ambiguous: SFUSD's construction contract with McCarthy was $95.39M, but a trade-press piece at the 2026 opening cites $129M as the project total, with no breakdown of the difference found.
No SFUSD document names a square-footage figure officially; the 81,800/82,000 sq ft figures come from trade press, not the district itself.
No openly licensed image was found; none is hosted here.
